rows.grounds: compound of yathā-ukta, padma-madhya, and stha, qualifying vāsudevaṃ as the visualized form
object of the act of contemplation

items.question: In what specific form and seat should Vāsudeva be contemplated during the prescribed worship?
premises: The prescribed object of contemplation is Vāsudeva.
Vāsudeva is to be visualized seated in the middle of a lotus.
The lotus corresponds to the form previously described.
items.inference: Therefore the practitioner should contemplate Vāsudeva abiding in the center of the lotus as previously specified.
items.plain_english: One should contemplate Vāsudeva seated in the middle of the lotus as previously described.
